title: Choose Rebound’s new visual world
question: Each direction redesigns every public surface while preserving the Rebound mark, product story, routes, and waitlist conversion.

options.label: Exposed Binding
options.lineage: bookbinding signatures, page edges, thread, and colophon marks
options.thesis: The entire website behaves like a book being assembled into one connected operating record.
options.viewport: A split-open book fills the first screen: one signature carries the product promise while the other binds scan, inventory, list, and sell into a continuous edge.
options.risk: Book craft can feel boutique unless the product demonstrations stay operational and precise.

raised.raise: The product data becomes more immediate, coded, and visibly live.
Every route reads as one continuous section through the book lifecycle.
The first viewport commits to a sharper silhouette and harder contrast.

options.label: Auction Catalogue
options.lineage: annotated rare-book auction catalogues and dealer lot sheets
options.thesis: Every Rebound capability is presented as a catalogued lot with evidence, condition, value, and provenance.
options.viewport: A monumental lot page introduces Rebound beside one annotated book record whose value and lifecycle are visible in the margins.
options.risk: The most naturally legible direction, but also the closest to familiar editorial web design.

options.label: Reseller Teletext
options.thesis: Rebound becomes a live reseller information service where every capability has a fast, numbered destination.
options.viewport: A strict information grid shows live sourcing data, the lifecycle index, and a direct early-access command.
options.case: Exceptionally memorable and data-native, but less familiar and comfortable for long marketing reads.
options.risk: Can become retro novelty if the grid loses discipline or uses too many colors.

options.label: Lifecycle Section
options.thesis: The site cuts through Rebound in section, revealing how one book moves through every operational room.
options.viewport: One continuous sectional drawing carries a book from scan to sale while the product promise rides the moving band of light.
options.case: Strong lifecycle clarity and spatial memory, though it requires authored sectional illustration across the system.
options.risk: The architectural metaphor may initially feel less connected to books than binding or catalogue systems.

options.label: Hard-Cut Programme
options.thesis: The product launch unfolds as a hard-edged programme of operational acts.
options.viewport: A dramatic stepped promise introduces the operational acts.
options.case: Memorable, but too theatrical for sustained product trust.
options.kept: Commit the first viewport to a decisive silhouette.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A premium contemporary SaaS site with large type, product frames, and cobalt conversion actions.
canonCard.viewport: The current Rebound structure executed at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Clear and professional, but not meaningfully more memorable than the existing site.
